shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Chaupai.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਕਰ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਭੋਗ ਲਗਾਵੈ॥
verses.translit_en: teh kar gur ko bhog lagaavai||

en.bdb: After doing this one is ready to perform Bhog;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਰਾਵੈ॥੧੩੭॥
verses.translit_en: gur ko roop ridh maeh dharaavai||137||

en.bdb: Contemplate the forms of the Guru within his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਮੋ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਕਾਈ॥
verses.translit_en: guroo gra(n)th mo bhedh na kaiee||

en.bdb: See no difference between Guru's Physical form and the Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji.
If Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji is present, it should be offered in their presence.
Next summon the Khalsas;
Have them sit in lines and give them respect.
Serve everyone equally.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਵ ਨ ਮਨ ਮੈਂ ਲੇਈ॥੧੪੦॥
verses.translit_en: dhoojaa bhaav na man mai(n) leiee||140||

en.bdb: Hold no duality in your heart.
One who discriminates in the Pangat;
He is a great sinner even in the eyes of the ancient scriptures!
Thus one must serve all equally in the Pangat.
Where all the so-called high and so-called low become the same.
Sit and place the food on cleansed grounds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਟੀਆ ਪਰ ਬਹਿ ਕਬੀ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ॥੧੪੩॥
verses.translit_en: khaTeeaa par beh kabee na khaavai||143||

en.bdb: Never sit and eat upon elevated seating.
This is not how Singhs are to act;
One must discriminate between truthfulness and falsehood.
If any poor man or woman comes for the Langar;
Readily distribute the langar to them; serve whoever comes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਭੀ ਕੁਛ ਅੰਨ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ॥
verses.translit_en: tin ko bhee kuchh a(n)n dhivaavai||

en.bdb: Give them provisions such as food;
Never let them leave empty handed.
By keeping the tradition of Langar this way;
One gains the merit akin to numerous pilgrimages and yagyas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੰਦ ਲਾਲ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਨ ਹੋ ਭਾਈ॥
verses.translit_en: na(n)dh laal tum sun ho bhaiee||

en.bdb: O'Nand Lal, listen O'Brother!
The tradition of Langar that I have related to you;

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਸਹੀ ਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹ ਕਰ ਗਹੋ॥
verses.translit_en: eisahee ko tum dhiraRh kar gaho||

en.bdb: You must keep this resolute and firm.
It is my command, to maintain this as an essential part of the Rehit.
If there is a wealthy royal Singhs;
He must prepare large amounts of food for the poor.
He should always follow this practice of oneness.
A Singh is he one who's intellectual will shine ever so brightly.
